verdict.rationale: MoonPay clearly documents an off-ramp (sell) flow — crypto to bank account or Visa card payout, MFA login, payout method selection, and requote webhooks — showing real off-ramp rails exist. However, the evidence never specifies stablecoins in particular nor publishes a concrete list of supported currencies/countries for payouts, which is central to the story's 'published set of currencies and countries' claim. Missing for 10: a published country/currency coverage list, explicit stablecoin-to-fiat mapping, and confirmation of local bank-transfer rails per region.
